name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels, core engaged.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Push through your palms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands close together, forming a diamond shape with your index fingers and thumbs.
Keep your body in a straight line and core tight.
Lower your chest toward your hands by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Wide Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank position with hands placed wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your core engaged and body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor, allowing elbows to flare out to the sides.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Decline Push-Up
instructions: Place your feet on an elevated surface such as a bench or step.
Position your hands on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Push back up to the starting position and repeat.

name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Start in a downward dog position with hips raised high, forming an inverted V shape.
Place hands shoulder-width apart on the floor.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Handstand Push-Up
instructions: Kick up into a handstand against a wall with hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line.
Slowly lower yourself by bending your elbows until the top of your head lightly touches the floor.
Press back up to full arm extension.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Pseudo Planche Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position but place your hands by your waist with fingers pointing to the sides or slightly backward.
Lean your shoulders forward past your hands.
Keep your core engaged and body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor while maintaining the forward lean.
Push back up to the starting position and repeat.

name: Archer Push-Up
instructions: Start in a wide push-up position with hands placed much wider than shoulder-width.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that arm while keeping the other arm straight.
Lower your chest toward the bent arm side.
Push back up to the starting position.
Alternate sides or complete all reps on one side before switching.

name: One-Arm Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with feet wider than shoulder-width for balance.
Place one hand behind your back.
Engage your core tightly to prevent rotation.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending the working arm.
Push back up to the starting position. Complete all reps then switch arms.

name: Dips
instructions: Grip the parallel bars and lift yourself up to the starting position with arms straight.
Lean slightly forward to emphasize the chest.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Push back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Ring Dips
instructions: Grip the gymnastic rings and lift yourself to a support hold with arms straight and rings turned out.
Keep the rings close to your body and core engaged.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your shoulders are below your elbows.
Press back up to the top position, turning the rings out at the top.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Bar Muscle-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a false (thumbless) grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Generate a slight swing or kip and pull explosively, bringing your hips toward the bar.
As your chest reaches bar height, transition by leaning over the bar.
Press out to full arm extension above the bar.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

name: Ring Muscle-Up
instructions: Hang from gymnastic rings with a false grip.
Pull yourself up explosively while bringing the rings close to your chest.
Transition through the bottom of a dip by rolling your shoulders over the rings.
Press out to a full support hold on top of the rings.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

name: Clap Push-Up
instructions: Start in a standard push-up position.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up explosively so your hands leave the ground.
Clap your hands together in mid-air.
Land with soft elbows and immediately go into the next repetition.

name: Hindu Push-Up
instructions: Start in a downward dog position with hips raised high.
Swoop your chest down and forward, skimming close to the floor.
Continue the motion upward into an upward dog position with hips low and chest lifted.
Reverse the motion back to the downward dog position.
Repeat in a fluid, continuous motion.

name: Bench Tricep Dips
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with hands gripping the edge beside your hips.
Slide your hips off the bench with legs extended or bent.
Lower your body by bending your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Push back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands on an elevated surface like a bench, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs back so your body forms a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the elevated surface by bending your elbows.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Ring Push-Up
instructions: Set rings at a low height and grip them in a push-up position.
Keep your body in a straight line with core engaged.
Lower your chest between the rings by bending your elbows.
Push back up, turning the rings out at the top of the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Elevated Pike Push-Up
instructions: Place your feet on an elevated surface and assume a pike position with hips high.
Hands should be shoulder-width apart on the floor.
Lower your head toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Push back up to the starting pike position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Explosive Push-Up
instructions: Start in a standard push-up position.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Push up as explosively as possible so your hands leave the ground.
Land softly with slightly bent elbows to absorb impact.
Immediately descend into the next rep.

name: Staggered Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with one hand placed higher than the other.
Keep your core engaged and body straight.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending both elbows.
Push back up to the starting position.
Switch hand positions after completing reps on one side.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a pronated (overhand) grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Engage your back muscles and pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Keep your core tight and avoid excessive swinging.
Lower yourself back down with control to a full hang.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a supinated (underhand) grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Focus on squeezing your biceps and back at the top.
Lower yourself with control to a full dead hang.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a wide overhand grip, hands well outside shoulder-width.
Pull yourself up by driving your elbows down and back.
Aim to bring your chest toward the bar.
Lower yourself back to a full hang with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Archer Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a wide overhand grip.
Pull yourself up toward one hand while keeping the other arm straight.
Your chin should reach the pulling hand at the top.
Lower back down with control.
Alternate sides or complete all reps on one side before switching.

name: L-Sit Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar and raise your legs to a 90-degree L-sit position.
Maintain the L-sit throughout the entire movement.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself back down with control, keeping legs parallel to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Typewriter Pull-Up
instructions: Pull yourself up above the bar with a wide overhand grip.
At the top, shift your body laterally toward one hand, keeping your chin above the bar.
Slide across to the other hand while staying above the bar.
This lateral movement counts as one rep.
Lower down after completing the desired slides.

name: Front Lever Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
With straight arms, engage your lats and core to raise your body until it is horizontal.
Keep your body straight and rigid throughout the movement.
Lower back down with control to the hanging position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Front Lever Hold
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Engage your lats and core to raise your entire body to a horizontal position.
Keep your body straight and rigid, parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for the desired duration.
Lower down with control when finished.

name: Back Lever
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar and perform a skin the cat to rotate backward.
Slowly lower your body until it is horizontal, face down.
Keep your body straight and core engaged.
Hold the position for the desired duration.
Tuck your knees and rotate back to the starting position to exit safely.

name: Inverted Row
instructions: Set a bar at waist height and hang underneath it with an overhand grip.
Keep your body in a straight line with heels on the ground.
Pull your chest up toward the bar by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself back down with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Australian Pull-Up
instructions: Set a bar at about hip height and grip it with an underhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet forward so your body is at an angle under the bar.
Keep your body straight and pull your chest to the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

name: Toes-to-Bar
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Engage your core and initiate a slight kip if needed.
Raise both legs with control until your toes touch the bar.
Lower your legs back down with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Close-Grip Chin-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an underhand grip, hands about 6 inches apart.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Focus on squeezing your biceps and lats at the top.
Lower yourself with control to a full hang.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Commando Pull-Up
instructions: Stand perpendicular to the bar and grip it with both hands in a staggered position, palms facing each other.
Pull yourself up, bringing one shoulder to the bar.
Lower back down with control.
Pull up again, this time bringing the opposite shoulder to the bar.
Alternate sides for each repetition.

name: Ring Row
instructions: Set rings at about waist height and grip them with arms extended.
Walk your feet forward so your body is at an angle, the steeper the harder.
Keep your body straight and pull your chest toward the rings.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower back with control and repeat.

name: Pistol Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other leg extended straight in front of you.
Extend your arms forward for balance.
Slowly lower yourself by bending the standing leg into a deep squat.
Go as low as possible while keeping the extended leg off the floor.
Push through the standing foot to return to the starting position.

name: Shrimp Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg and grab the foot of your free leg behind you.
Keep your torso upright and core engaged.
Slowly lower yourself by bending the standing leg until the knee of the rear leg touches the floor.
Push through the standing foot to return to the starting position.
Complete all reps on one side before switching.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand about two feet in front of a bench and place one foot behind you on the bench.
Keep your torso upright and core engaged.
Lower your body by bending the front knee until the rear knee nearly touches the floor.
Push through the front heel to return to the starting position.
Complete all reps on one side before switching legs.

name: Jump Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat position with thighs parallel to the floor.
Explode upward, jumping as high as possible.
Land softly with bent knees to absorb the impact.
Immediately descend into the next squat and repeat.

name: Box Jump
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or platform at an appropriate height.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back to generate momentum.
Jump onto the box, landing softly with both feet flat on top.
Stand fully upright on the box.
Step back down carefully and repeat.

name: Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step with your heels hanging off.
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible.
Hold the top position for a moment and squeeze your calves.
Lower your heels below the step level for a full stretch.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Nordic Curl
instructions: Kneel on a pad with your feet anchored under something sturdy.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Slowly lower your torso toward the ground by extending at the knees.
Control the descent as long as possible, using your hamstrings to resist gravity.
Catch yourself with your hands and push back up, using your hamstrings to pull you back to the start.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Press through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips off the floor.
Raise your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Hold at the top for a moment, squeezing your glutes.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

name: Step-Up
instructions: Stand facing a bench or elevated platform.
Step up with one foot, pressing through the heel.
Drive your body up until the working leg is fully extended.
Step back down with control.
Alternate legs or complete all reps on one side first.

name: Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step forward with one leg and lower your hips until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Keep your front knee tracking over your toes and your torso upright.
Push through the front heel to return to the starting position.
Alternate legs with each repetition.

name: Jump Lunge
instructions: Start in a lunge position with one foot forward and one back.
Jump explosively into the air.
Switch your leg positions mid-air.
Land softly in a lunge with the opposite leg forward.
Immediately jump again and continue alternating.

name: Sissy Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding onto a support for balance if needed.
Rise onto your toes and lean your torso backward.
Bend your knees and lower your body, pushing your knees forward while keeping your torso and thighs in a straight line.
Go as low as possible while maintaining balance.
Push through your toes to return to the starting position.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Extend your arms forward for balance.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat.
Go as low as your mobility allows while keeping your chest up and back straight.
Push through your heels to return to standing.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on one foot on the edge of a step, heel hanging off.
Hold onto something for balance if needed.
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible.
Lower your heel below the step for a full stretch.
Complete all reps then switch to the other leg.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat on the floor; extend the other leg straight.
Press through the grounded heel to lift your hips.
Keep the extended leg straight and in line with your torso.
Squeeze your glute at the top and hold briefly.
Lower with control and complete all reps before switching legs.

name: Plank
instructions: Start in a forearm plank position with elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core by drawing your navel toward your spine.
Do not let your hips sag or pike up.
Hold for the desired duration while breathing steadily.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm on the ground, elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet on top of each other.
Lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from head to feet.
Engage your core and hold the position.
Hold for the desired duration then switch sides.

name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back firmly into the floor.
Lift your arms, shoulders, and legs off the ground simultaneously.
Maintain a slight banana shape with your body.
Hold for the desired duration while breathing steadily.

name: L-Sit
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars or the floor with arms straight.
Lift your legs until they are parallel to the ground, forming an L shape.
Keep your legs straight and toes pointed.
Engage your core and maintain a straight torso.
Hold for the desired duration.

name: V-Sit
instructions: Sit on the floor and place your hands beside your hips.
Lift your legs straight while simultaneously leaning your torso back slightly.
Raise your legs above the L-sit position toward a V shape.
Keep your arms straight if performing on parallettes, or balance on your sit bones on the floor.
Hold for the desired duration.

name: Dragon Flag
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip the bench behind your head for support.
Lift your entire body off the bench, pivoting only on your upper back and shoulders.
Keep your body straight and rigid from shoulders to toes.
Slowly lower your body toward the bench without letting it touch.
Raise back up to the starting position and repeat.

name: Human Flag
instructions: Grip a vertical pole with both hands, one above the other, in an overhand and underhand grip.
Push with the bottom arm and pull with the top arm.
Engage your entire core and lift your body to a horizontal position.
Keep your body straight and rigid, parallel to the ground.
Hold for the desired duration.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel on the floor and grip an ab wheel or use sliders with your hands.
Slowly roll forward, extending your arms and lowering your torso toward the floor.
Go as far as you can while maintaining a flat back and tight core.
Pull yourself back to the starting position using your abs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Keep your legs straight and together.
Raise your legs until they are parallel to the ground or higher.
Lower your legs back down with control, avoiding swinging.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Windshield Wipers
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar and raise your legs until your toes touch the bar.
Keeping your legs straight and together, rotate them to one side.
Control the movement and rotate to the opposite side.
Continue alternating like a windshield wiper.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in a high plank position with hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Quickly switch legs, extending the bent leg back while driving the other knee forward.
Continue alternating legs at a rapid pace.
Maintain a flat back and engaged core throughout.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back with arms extended toward the ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Slowly extend one arm overhead and the opposite leg straight, lowering both toward the floor.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides while keeping your lower back pressed to the floor.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and feet lifted slightly off the ground.
Lean back slightly and clasp your hands together in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side, bringing your hands toward the floor beside your hip.
Rotate to the other side in a controlled manner.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with hands behind your head and legs lifted, knees bent at 90 degrees.
Bring your right elbow toward your left knee while extending the right leg.
Switch sides, bringing the left elbow toward the right knee.
Continue alternating in a pedaling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor throughout.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Engage your core and lift your knees toward your chest.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your legs back down with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Handstand Hold
instructions: Place your hands shoulder-width apart on the floor, about a foot from a wall.
Kick up into a handstand with your heels resting against the wall for support.
Engage your core, squeeze your glutes, and point your toes.
Keep your arms straight and push the floor away through your shoulders.
Hold for the desired duration and come down with control.

name: Freestanding Handstand
instructions: Place your hands shoulder-width apart on the floor.
Kick up into a handstand without wall support.
Use finger and wrist pressure to maintain balance.
Keep your body in a straight line with core and glutes engaged.
Hold for the desired duration, adjusting balance constantly.

name: Frog Stand
instructions: Squat down and place your hands flat on the floor, shoulder-width apart.
Place your knees on the backs of your upper arms, near your elbows.
Lean forward slowly, shifting your weight onto your hands.
Lift your feet off the ground and balance on your hands.
Hold the position for the desired duration.

name: Crow Pose
instructions: Squat down and place your hands shoulder-width apart on the floor.
Place your knees against the backs of your upper arms.
Lean forward, shifting your weight onto your hands.
Lift both feet off the floor and balance with arms slightly bent.
Hold the position, keeping your gaze slightly forward for balance.

name: Planche Lean
instructions: Start in a push-up position with hands by your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Lean your shoulders as far forward past your hands as possible.
Keep your arms straight and core engaged.
Protract your shoulder blades (push them apart).
Hold the forward lean for the desired duration.

name: Skin the Cat
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar or rings with an overhand grip.
Tuck your knees to your chest and roll backward, passing your feet between your arms.
Extend your legs as you rotate into a German hang position below and behind the bar.
Hold briefly and then reverse the movement to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Tuck Planche
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars or the floor with straight arms.
Lean forward and tuck your knees tightly to your chest.
Lift your hips until your back is parallel to the ground.
Keep your arms straight and shoulder blades protracted.
Hold for the desired duration.

name: L-Sit to Handstand
instructions: Start in an L-sit position on parallel bars with legs extended.
Slowly press your legs upward, transitioning through a straddle or pike.
Continue pressing until you reach a full handstand position.
Maintain straight arms and engaged core throughout.
Hold the handstand briefly, then lower with control back to the L-sit.

name: Elbow Lever
instructions: Place your hands on the floor and dig one or both elbows into your lower abdomen.
Lean forward, shifting your weight onto your hands.
Extend your legs behind you and lift them off the ground.
Balance horizontally on your hands with elbows supporting your body.
Hold for the desired duration.

name: Press to Handstand
instructions: Start standing with feet together and place your hands on the floor.
Lean forward, shifting your weight onto your hands with straight arms.
Slowly pike or straddle your legs upward using core and shoulder strength.
Press through your shoulders until you reach a full handstand.
Hold at the top, then lower with control.

name: Wall Walk
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your feet against a wall.
Walk your feet up the wall while simultaneously walking your hands closer to the wall.
Continue until you are in a handstand position facing the wall.
Hold briefly at the top.
Walk your hands out and feet down to return to the starting position.

name: Burpee
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop into a squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a plank position and perform a push-up.
Jump your feet forward toward your hands.
Explode upward into a jump with arms overhead and repeat.

name: Plyometric Push-Up
instructions: Start in a standard push-up position.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up explosively, launching your upper body off the ground.
Land with soft elbows and immediately descend into the next rep.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Broad Jump
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms back and bend your knees to load the jump.
Explode forward and upward, jumping as far as possible.
Swing your arms forward to generate momentum.
Land softly with bent knees and absorb the impact.

name: Tuck Jump
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Jump as high as possible.
At the peak of the jump, tuck your knees to your chest.
Extend your legs and land softly with bent knees.
Immediately jump again and repeat.

name: Lateral Bound
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Jump laterally to the opposite side, landing on the other foot.
Absorb the landing with a bent knee and stabilize.
Immediately bound back to the starting side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired repetitions.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall.
Slide down until your thighs are parallel to the floor and knees are at 90 degrees.
Keep your back flat against the wall and feet flat on the floor.
Hold this position for the desired duration.
Push back up to standing when finished.

name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot backward and lower your hips until both knees are at about 90 degrees.
Keep your front knee tracking over your toes and torso upright.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs or complete all reps on one side first.

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
instructions: Start on all fours with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and arch your back, dropping your belly toward the floor and lifting your head (cow).
Exhale and round your spine toward the ceiling, tucking your chin to chest (cat).
Move slowly between the two positions with each breath.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Deep Squat Hold
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, toes turned out.
Lower into the deepest squat you can achieve with heels on the ground.
Place your elbows against the insides of your knees and press them apart.
Keep your chest up and back straight.
Hold for the desired duration, breathing deeply.

name: Thoracic Bridge
instructions: Sit on the floor with one hand behind you and the opposite foot flat on the floor.
Push through your supporting hand and foot to lift your hips.
Rotate your torso and extend the free arm overhead, creating a bridge.
Hold briefly at the top, opening your chest toward the ceiling.
Lower with control and repeat on the other side.

name: Bridge (Full)
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, close to your glutes.
Place your hands by your ears with fingers pointing toward your shoulders.
Push through your hands and feet to lift your hips and chest off the floor.
Straighten your arms and legs as much as possible, forming an arch.
Hold for the desired duration and lower down with control.

name: Pike Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended straight in front of you.
Keeping your back straight, hinge at the hips and reach toward your toes.
Go as far as your flexibility allows without rounding your lower back.
Hold the stretch for the desired duration.
Breathe deeply and try to deepen the stretch with each exhale.

name: Superman
instructions: Lie face down on the floor with arms extended overhead.
Simultaneously lift your arms, chest, and legs off the ground.
Squeeze your glutes and lower back muscles at the top.
Hold for a moment, then lower back down with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Bear Crawl
instructions: Start on all fours with knees hovering about an inch off the ground.
Move forward by simultaneously advancing the opposite hand and foot.
Keep your hips low and back flat throughout the movement.
Continue crawling forward for the desired distance.
You can also crawl backward or laterally for variation.

name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold a resistance band in front of you at shoulder height with arms extended.
Grip the band with both hands, palms facing down.
Pull the band apart by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Stretch the band until it touches your chest.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat.

name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Loop a resistance band over a pull-up bar.
Place one or both feet into the band loop.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Pull yourself up with the assistance of the band until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself with control and repeat.
